name: Research one retained Tier 2 Government Civic through the official native setter and a fresh-turn read

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local p=b.CaptiveCapacityPlan(); local t=p.government and p.government.target; local d=b.EnemyRetryDiagnosis(); assert(p.stage=='NEEDS_TIER2_CIVIC' and t and t.tier=='Tier2' and not t.civicOwned and (t.governmentType=='GOVERNMENT_MERCHANT_REPUBLIC' or t.governmentType=='GOVERNMENT_MONARCHY') and d.spyID==655368 and d.eventID==0 and d.outcome=='CAPTURED' and d.occupied==1 and d.capacity==1 and d.captive.captor==1 and d.captive.nameIndex==-1,'Tier 2 Civic candidate or original captive differs'); b.Queue('PREPARE_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC'); return 'one official retained Tier 2 prerequisite Civic queued'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_PREPARE_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC' or a=='UNKNOWN_PREPARE_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC' or a=='REJECTED_PREPARE_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_PREPARE_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC' or a=='PENDING_PREPARE_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC'
local a=Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_TIER2_CIVIC_ATTEMPT'); local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return a and p and p:IsTurnActive() and Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()==a.turn+1

steps.code: ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.Queue('RESUME_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC_READ'); return 'read-only Tier 2 Civic recheck queued after one real turn'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_RESUME_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC_READ' or a=='UNKNOWN_RESUME_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC_READ' or a=='REJECTED_RESUME_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC_READ' or a=='PENDING_RESUME_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC_READ' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_RESUME_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC_READ'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local p=b.CaptiveCapacityPlan(); local a=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_TIER2_CIVIC_ATTEMPT')); local c=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_TIER2_CIVIC_RECEIPT')); local r=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_TIER2_CIVIC_READ')); local m=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_TIER2_CIVIC')); local d=b.EnemyRetryDiagnosis(); assert((p.stage=='NEEDS_TIER2_GOVERNMENT' or p.stage=='TIER2_GOVERNMENT_BLOCKED') and p.government.target.governmentType==a.targetGovernment and p.government.target.civicOwned and a.owner==0 and a.sequence==a.token and c.phase=='SETTER_RETURNED' and c.token==a.token and c.index==a.index and r.action=='RESUME_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC_READ' and r.status=='OBSERVED' and r.owned and r.index==a.index and r.originalToken==a.token and r.originalTurn==a.turn and r.turn==a.turn+1 and m.owner==0 and m.index==a.index and m.civicType==a.civicType and m.targetGovernment==a.targetGovernment and m.originalToken==a.token and m.originalSequence==a.sequence and m.token==r.token and m.readSerial==r.serial and m.commandTurn==a.turn and m.turn==r.turn and m.beforeSpent==a.beforeSpent and m.afterSpent==m.beforeSpent and d.spyID==655368 and d.eventID==0 and d.outcome=='CAPTURED' and d.occupied==1 and d.capacity==1 and d.captive.captor==1 and d.captive.nameIndex==-1,'native Tier 2 Civic, title, retained Government or original captive differs'); return p.stage
